inv.desc_es:
PALOS DE LA FRONTERA. 
 
 Excelente local comercial de unos 400 m² distribuido en dos plantas, calle arbolada y tranquila, con el encanto discreto del barrio de Palos de la Frontera (Arganzuela).
 
 Situado en una zona de gran tránsito peatonal y alto potencial comercial. Ideal para múltiples usos: oficinas, academia, supermercado, entre otros. Nota: no dispone de salida de humos.
 
 Destacan sus techos altos que aportan amplitud y luminosidad, además de estar situado en un edificio de calidad.
 
 Goza de una ubicación privilegiada, muy cerca de la estación de Atocha y con magníficas conexiones en transporte público, metro, tren y autobús a pocos pasos, lo que combina comodidad con alta visibilidad.

inv.desc_en:
PALOS DE LA FRONTERA.

Excellent commercial premises of approximately 400 m² distributed over two floors, on a tree-lined and quiet street, with the discreet charm of the Palos de la Frontera neighborhood (Arganzuela).

Located in an area of high pedestrian traffic and high commercial potential. Ideal for multiple uses: offices, academy, supermarket, among others. Note: it does not have a smoke outlet.

Its high ceilings, which provide spaciousness and brightness, are noteworthy, as is its location in a quality building.

It enjoys a privileged location, very close to Atocha station and with magnificent public transport connections, metro, train, and bus just a few steps away, combining convenience with high visibility.

INMUGA HOMES, SL. Fly towards your next home. More properties at: inmuga. com

We accompany you throughout the entire process with personalized attention and total transparency, to provide maximum security in the experience of a real estate transaction.

We resolve any queries or doubts, both fiscal and legal.

We find the ideal FINANCING according to your needs or expectations.

We offer professional services to process sales, capital gains tax settlements, inheritances, mortgage cancellations, lifting of embargoes, energy efficiency certificates (CEE), and other property-related matters.
